      <text x="309" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit report</text>
    </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="744" width="354" height="27" rx="3" fill="#D9D5EC"/>
    <circle cx="33" cy="757" r="7" fill="#25213B"/>
    <text x="31" y="761" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="49" y="761" font-family="Public Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#25213B">Need immediate help? Contact support.</text>
